name: Armada Guest House
accommodation: Rooms from single economy to family en-suite
confirmedFeatures: Free Wi-Fi, TV, welcome tray, breakfast, long-stay rates
overview: A guest house about 100 yards from Redcar's beach, offering everything from single economy rooms to en-suite family rooms. Breakfast is served, and there are reduced rates for longer stays. The seafront and town centre are both a short walk.
surfTripFit: A hundred yards from the sand, it is a simple, walkable base for a surf trip.
